_comment: Smoke-test-only params file. Not used for real experiments — see .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 1 and .specs/quality/testing-strategy.md. Points at the tiny DATA/daninhas_micro/ dataset generated by scripts/make_micro_dataset.py (2 classes, 25 train + 10 test images per class) so `make smoke` / tests/test_golden_run.py can run demo.py end-to-end on CPU in a few seconds.

config_kmh._comment: Sized for the micro dataset's ~40-image unlabeled pool (50 train images - 10 initial labeled). Only exercised by the hierarchical strategies (SSRAEKmeansHCSampling/VCTexKmeansHCSampling), which are not smoke-tested here (see known-issues.md KI-13: hardcoded device='cuda'). Kept for schema completeness only.
